decisions.reason: The construction site dumper builds directly on the firm's experience with robust carrier vehicles and its application know-how, so the firm can learn from early results, although it was only briefly mentioned on the website and its weaker visibility adds some risk.

The inclined furniture lift sits squarely in the firm's established lifting know-how and service network, giving high absorptive capacity to interpret feedback and keep improving it, and it had a dedicated page.

The inclined building material lift shares design, components and customers with the firm's other lifts, so the firm's accumulated engineering knowledge makes continued refinement cheap and its market fit clear.

The truck-mounted furniture lift combines the firm's vehicle and lifting expertise, which it can readily assimilate and apply, although the vehicle integration adds slightly more complexity than the stationary lifts.
